Exam: mpMRI Prostate
Clinical indication: PSA 11.0 ng/mL, prior negative biopsy, elevated PSA velocity.
FINDINGS: Prostate volume measures 41.0 mL. T2-weighted imaging shows a symmetrically enlarged gland with preserved zonal anatomy. DWI reveals a subtle focal area of restricted diffusion in the right peripheral zone, posterior aspect, measuring approximately 8 mm in greatest dimension. This area demonstrates corresponding mild enhancement on DCE sequences. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified. No suspicious lymphadenopathy.
IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 3 lesion in the right peripheral zone. PSA density 0.27 ng/mL/mL. Clinical T stage cT1c. csPCa predicted probability 0.581638.
